subject: general
question: The "Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban (PMAY-U)" aims to address the housing shortage in urban areas. Which of the following approaches is a key component of this scheme to achieve its objectives?

options.text: Primarily focusing on providing rental housing for migrant workers.
Providing financial assistance to beneficiaries for the construction, purchase, or enhancement of affordable housing.
Mandating the use of only indigenous building materials in all PMAY-U projects.
Concentrating housing development efforts in Tier-1 and Tier-2 cities.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Providing financial assistance to beneficiaries for the construction, purchase, or enhancement of affordable housing**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 
• The **Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban (PMAY-U)** was launched in **2015** by the Government of India to address the urban housing shortage, especially among the economically weaker sections (EWS), low-income groups (LIG), and middle-income groups (MIG). 
• The scheme includes a component of **providing financial assistance** to eligible beneficiaries for constructing, purchasing, or enhancing affordable housing units. This is a key approach to achieving the scheme's objectives. 
• The financial assistance is provided through a **Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme (CLSS)**, under which beneficiaries can avail of interest subsidies on housing loans based on their income
